deprecated_yaml.description:
Your existing HTTP configuration from `configuration.yaml` has been imported. The `http` integration is now configured from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.

Please remove the `http:` block from your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml.title: The HTTP YAML configuration is deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_error.description: Migrating the `http` configuration from `configuration.yaml` to the integration's storage failed. Please check the logs for details and configure the `http` integration from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.
deprecated_yaml_import_error.title: Failed to import HTTP YAML configuration

ssl_configured_without_configured_urls.description:
Home Assistant detected that SSL has been set up on your instance, however, no custom external internet URL has been set.

This may result in unexpected behavior. Text-to-speech may fail, and integrations may not be able to connect back to your instance correctly.

To address this issue, go to Settings > System > Network; under the "Home Assistant URL" section, configure your new "Internet" and "Local network" addresses that match your new SSL configuration.
ssl_configured_without_configured_urls.title: SSL is configured without an external URL or internal URL

abort.issue_ignored: This repair is ignored and the `{profile}` profile stays in use.
abort.pending_config: A new HTTP configuration is already waiting to be applied or confirmed. Confirm or revert it first.

confirm_intermediate_v6.description: Home Assistant restarts with the **Intermediate v6** profile and asks you to confirm the new configuration. Clients that depend on the legacy ciphers of `{profile}`, such as Windows 7 and 8.1 using Internet Explorer or other system TLS with an RSA certificate, can no longer connect. Unless you confirm within 5 minutes, it restores the `{profile}` profile automatically.
confirm_intermediate_v6.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

confirm_modern_v6.description: Home Assistant restarts with the **Modern v6** profile and asks you to confirm the new configuration. Clients without TLS 1.3 support can no longer connect. Unless you confirm within 5 minutes, it restores the `{profile}` profile automatically.
confirm_modern_v6.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

ignore.description: This repair will be hidden and the `{profile}` profile stays in use. You can change the profile at any time under **Settings** > **System** > **Network** > **HTTP server** > **SSL/TLS**.
ignore.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

init.description:
The HTTP server uses the SSL profile `{profile}`, which follows outdated Mozilla TLS guidelines: it accepts TLS 1.2 and newer, but still allows legacy ciphers such as CBC suites, RSA key exchange, or DHE.

We recommend **Modern v6**, which accepts TLS 1.3 only. Browsers, mobile apps, and operating systems have supported TLS 1.3 since around 2018 to 2019, so most setups are not affected. Choose **Intermediate v6** instead if devices that stopped receiving updates before then, such as older smart TVs, cameras, or hubs, connect to Home Assistant directly. It accepts TLS 1.2 and newer with current ciphers.

Oldest clients that can connect:

| Profile | Chrome | Firefox | Safari | iOS | Android | Edge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Modern v6 | 70 | 63 | 12.1 | 12.2 | 10 | 75 |
| Intermediate v6 | 49 | 31 | 9 | 9 | 4.4 | 15 |

Clients that depend on the legacy ciphers, such as Windows 7 and 8.1 using Internet Explorer or other system TLS with an RSA certificate, can only keep connecting with `{profile}`.

Either upgrade is applied as a trial and reverts automatically unless you confirm the new configuration within 5 minutes. You can close this dialog to decide later, or change the profile at any time under **Settings** > **System** > **Network** > **HTTP server** > **SSL/TLS**.

menu_options.ignore: Keep the current profile and ignore this repair

init.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

yaml_still_present_after_migration.description: The HTTP configuration in `configuration.yaml` has already been migrated and is now being ignored. Please remove the `http:` block from your `configuration.yaml`. Manage the HTTP configuration from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.
yaml_still_present_after_migration.title: HTTP YAML configuration is ignored after migration
